nodes.label: UX Smoothening Phase 2 — PR1a Plan (narrowed)
nodes.rationale: Narrowed by critical review: B1 dropped because a composition refactor would relitigate a closed Phase 1 decision, C1 dropped as low-value polish, and the C2 icon swap dropped because the proposed glyphs were admitted mediocre. What remains is two small additive changes.

nodes.label: History-panel per-cell memory tooltip
nodes.rationale: Threads country/city name + score into each calendar cell as a title="" tooltip. Accepted as a desktop-only affordance because title tooltips only render on hover; the cell's primary affordance stays navigate-to-reveal on tap, so mobile loses nothing.

nodes.label: Satellite-toggle title attribute
nodes.rationale: The title mirrors the action of clicking ('Switch to map view' when satellite is on) rather than the current state, so the hint answers what will happen. A data-satellite-active attribute is added purely so e2e can assert state without reading pixels.
